text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High GPU utilization + HPA not scaling for inference-serving-prod (detected queue growth). Please respond.
Maria Chen: ack — I'm on call. seeing autoscale alerts, queue length spiking to 7k.
Tom Patel: i'm looking at the metrics pipeline. prometheus scrape looks ok for node metrics but custom-metrics-adapter logs show timeouts.
Maria Chen: confirm customer impact? any 5xx/429s?
Jenna Park: CS reports multiple customers seeing degraded throughput and increased 429 rate for batch endpoints. some jobs stalling then retrying.
Aisha Khan: from the frontend side some streaming sessions are timing out after 30s, fallback to polling triggered.
Maria Chen: k, I'm running `kubectl get hpa -n inference-serving` to check HPA status. output: ```NAME                    REFERENCE                 TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE\ninference-gpu-hpa       Deployment/inference-dep   0%/80%    2         20        2          3h``` which shows HPA not reacting.
Tom Patel: that 0%/80% is because custom metric hasn't been reported. adapter logs show `failed to get metrics: upstream timeout` repeatedly.
Kyle Rodriguez: any recent deploys to the metrics stack? deploy-bot: deploy to metrics-adapter at 1860000085 by eng-ml (canary) - success.
Tom Patel: looks like the canary process crashed after a few minutes, adapter restarted but lost connection to prometheus because of TLS handshake errors.
Maria Chen: can we get a manual scale while we triage? request to infra: please increase inference-deployment replicas to 8.
Aisha Khan: low-priority / background queues can we pause them or route to degraded class? I'll flip the routing to preserve capacity for customer requests.
Jenna Park: CS: we've notified affected customers and opened temporary support tickets.
Tom Patel: workaround: i'm going to restart the custom-metrics-adapter pod to clear the TLS state. command: ```kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/custom-metrics-adapter```
Maria Chen: manual scale applied: ```kubectl -n inference-serving scale deployment inference-dep --replicas=8``` — replicas now 8.
incident-bot: Note: manual scaling bypasses HPA. Remember to revert once autoscaling healthy.
Tom Patel: restart done. watching adapter logs: getting metrics from prometheus now, latency for `inference_queue_length` is ~200ms.
Maria Chen: HPA check: ```kubectl describe hpa inference-gpu-hpa -n inference-serving``` shows last scale event 20m ago, metrics now present.
Maria Chen: HPA now sees target metric: 5200/8000 (queue length / target) — it's initiating scale.
Kyle Rodriguez: I'll take the overnight handoff at 1900 UTC. @Tom can you summarise what to watch in handoff?
Tom Patel: watch for `custom-metrics-adapter` restarts, `prometheus` scrape failures, `kube-metrics-server` errors, and HPA events. If adapter regresses, we should consider a hotfix reverting the canary image.
Aisha Khan: I'll keep routing policy in degraded mode for 30m to let scale settle.
Jenna Park: updating customers: we expect throughput to recover in 10-20 minutes as nodes finish warmups.
Maria Chen: postmortem notes: root cause seems to be metrics-adapter regression after canary deploy -> lost metrics -> HPA didn't scale -> queue grew -> GPUs exhausted -> throttling. mitigation sequence: 1) restart adapter, 2) manual scale to absorb load, 3) route low-priority work away, 4) revert canary if it reproduces.
Tom Patel: capturing commands and logs in case timeline needed. saving `kubectl logs -n monitoring deployment/custom-metrics-adapter > /tmp/adapter-logs.txt`.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: SRE Pager acknowledged by Maria Chen at 1860000022.
Maria Chen: handing off to Kyle now — full context in this thread. Kyle, contact Tom if adapter spikes again.
Kyle Rodriguez: taking handoff. I have playbook steps: check adapter pod restarts, `kubectl get hpa -A`, `kubectl get pods -n monitoring`, `kubectl top nodes`, and manual scale commands.
Maria Chen: leaving channel, good job everyone. :thumbsup:
Kyle Rodriguez: will keep monitoring. updating incident status to "mitigated" once queue drops below 500 and latency normalizes.
Jenna Park: CS will close affected tickets after final confirmation.
Customer Success Bot: Noted — customer notifications queued.
Tom Patel: follow-up action: revert canary and run integration test for adapter TLS handshakes before next canary. filing ticket: ENG-ML-3127.
Maria Chen: postmortem owner assigned: Maria Chen. timeline and RCA to be posted tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident status: MONITORING -> Mitigated pending.
Kyle Rodriguez: update at 1860001200: queue at 420, GPU util at 72%, no throttles reported. marking for closure in 30m if stable.
